sentences.text: The Royal Commission into Trade Union Governance and Corruption devoted this volume to proposals for law reform.
sentences.support:
This Volume of the Report is devoted to recommendations in relation 
to law reform.

sentences.text: It considered union regulation, officials’ duties, corrupting benefits, enterprise bargaining, competition, construction, entry rights and Royal Commission powers.
sentences.support:

sentences.text: The Commission considered that the benefits of national regulation justified governments exploring a single regime for employee and employer organisations.
sentences.support:
it is considered that the potential 
benefits justify the States and Commonwealth giving consideration to 
implementing a national regime

sentences.text: It recommended a separate, independent regulator for registered organisations and funding sufficient for that regulator to carry out its functions.
sentences.support:
The Registered Organisations Commission should 
be an independent stand-alone regulator.

findings.quote:
The Registered Organisations Commission should 
be an independent stand-alone regulator.

The Commonwealth government ensure that the registered organisations 
regulator is properly resourced to carry out its functions, with a separate budget 
for which it is accountable.

notes: This pack is Volume 5, Law Reform. It has no separate executive summary; the Introduction describes its purpose and structure. PDF page 24 says the complete recommendations list is in Volume 1, which is not this pack. Some pages have disrupted column order, including PDF page 59; those passages were not used as support.
